description: This file defines the LessBinary class, a part of Twig's expression evaluation system. It handles the less-than binary operation within Twig templates, specifically for PHP versions below 8.0. The class extends AbstractBinary and provides compilation logic for outputting PHP code that performs a less-than comparison in the template.

classes.name: LessBinary
classes.description: Represents a less-than binary expression node in Twig's abstract syntax tree. Implements compilation logic tailored for PHP versions below 8.0 to evaluate the less-than operation during template rendering.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for evaluating the less-than operation. Uses different compilation logic depending on PHP version, calling the parent method for PHP 8.0 and above, or generating inline comparison code for lower versions.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the string '<', representing the less-than operator, used internally during compilation.
